messages.content: Please check that calculation, correct it if needed, and give one way to verify it.

answer:
You're right to check — I made an error. 17 × 19 is **323**, not 313.

One way to verify it: rewrite 19 as (20 − 1) and use the distributive property.

17 × 19 = 17 × (20 − 1) = (17 × 20) − (17 × 1) = 340 − 17 = 323.

That confirms the answer. Thanks for catching that.
